name: refute-ui
note: This verification was run by the same session that wrote steps 9 and 10, so it is not an independent refutation of those two. Steps 1-8 came from the codex harness and are refuted here from the outside. An independent cross-verification of step 8 by a different agent is recorded at phases/48-joint-review-ui/step8-cross-verification-antigravity.md; it refuted two of that step's four claims, and those corrections are already folded into step8-report.json and handed to phase 49.

checks.result: uc25 statusVocabularyAndNotices is true and the review suite passes. The verdict-like words that exist in ja.json sit inside the disclaimers that negate them (review.work.notice, review.items.notice), which is what the notice requirement asks for.

checks.oracle: ripgrep for a literal backslash-u escape in src/components/review, src/lib/review, useReviewModel.ts and tests/e2e/uc25*.js
checks.result: No matches. An earlier bash grep reported four files, but the shell ate its backslash so it was matching the letter u followed by four hex characters inside ordinary identifiers such as excludedBy. That was a false positive of the oracle, not of the code.
